what_happened: Confirmed GOAL item 2 (hooks:false scope) by direct read of ~/.sapience/sapience_upkeep.py, mcp.py, sapience_cli.py rather than assuming from the dispatch's prose -- hooks_opted_out() gates only wire_hooks() and cli_auto_on_plan(), never the per-repo mcp.py/sapience_cli.py hook entry points, so no vendor-side or extension-side change is implicated, narrowing the fix to two jq sites in sapience.nix.

Research report section 3 recommended ordering the new hook-injection guard 'entryAfter [ writeBoundary claudeSettings ]'. Verified in modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix: claudeSettings resets 'hooks' as an ENFORCED key from config/claude/settings.json on every switch, so a guard ordered after it always inspects an already-cleaned file and can never fire. Plan corrects the ordering to entryBefore [ claudeSettings ] and re-derives the abort-vs-warn decision on that basis (aborting before the enforced-key merge would also forfeit the automatic strip).
